cancelPt.statement: Let $\mathbb k$ be an RCLike field (i.e. $\mathbb R$ or $\mathbb C$), $X$ a pseudometric space and $A\in\mathbb N$, and assume a `CompatibleFunctions 𝕜 X A` structure on $X$ (by its docstring, a compatible set $\Theta$ of continuous functions); in particular this gives a type $\Theta(X)$ with a map (`coeΘ`) into the continuous functions $X\to\mathbb k$, and its first axiom asserts that there exists a point $o\in X$ with $\theta(o)=0$ for every $\theta\in\Theta(X)$. Define `cancelPt X` $\in X$ (by its docstring, the point $o$ in the blueprint) to be a point chosen (via the axiom of choice, `Exists.choose`) among the points $o\in X$ such that every $\theta\in\Theta(X)$ vanishes at $o$; thus $\theta(\mathrm{cancelPt}\,X)=0$ for all $\theta\in\Theta(X)$.
